## 🚀 Quick Installation

### Method 1: Download Package (Recommended)
```bash
# Download package
wget https://github.com/robingladys/cpa-lead-dashboard/releases/download/v1.0.0/cpa-lead-dashboard-v1.0.0.tar.gz

# Extract
tar -xzf cpa-lead-dashboard-v1.0.0.tar.gz
cd cpa-lead-dashboard

# Auto-install
bash dist/install.sh

# Start
npm run dev
```

### Method 2: Clone Repository
```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/robingladys/cpa-lead-dashboard.git
cd cpa-lead-dashboard

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Setup database
npm run db:push

# Start
npm run dev
```

## 📋 Repository Contents

### Source Code
- ✅ Next.js 15 + TypeScript
- ✅ Prisma ORM + SQLite
- ✅ Socket.IO (real-time)
- ✅ Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
- ✅ API endpoints for 3 CPA platforms

### Documentation
- ✅ `dist/INSTALLATION.md` - Installation guide
- ✅ `dist/USER_GUIDE.md` - User guide
- ✅ `dist/QUICK_START.md` - Quick start
- ✅ `README.md` - Main documentation

### Configuration
- ✅ `dist/install.sh` - Auto-install script
- ✅ `Dockerfile` + `docker-compose.yml`
- ✅ `nginx.conf` - Production config
